scenarios.zh: 实际（两处山溪进水口被山泥堵塞） vs 进水口畅通
scenarios.en: Actual (two stream intakes blocked by debris) vs intakes clear
scenarios.desc_zh: A 按发展局答复重演：法藏寺、黄大仙祠两处进水口从 7 日 22:00 起被塌下的山泥堵塞，溪水随山势涌下沙田坳道；B 假设两处进水口一直畅通，其余完全相同。
scenarios.desc_en: A replays the Development Bureau account: the Fat Jong Temple and Wong Tai Sin Temple intakes blocked by landslide debris from 22:00 on the 7th, the streams running down Shatin Pass Road; B assumes both intakes stayed clear, everything else equal.
